```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
cameras = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a figure with a specific size
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))

# Create a box plot to visualize the distribution of prices by brand
sns.boxplot(x='brand', y='price_usd', data=cameras)

# Rotate x-axis labels for better readability
plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right')

# Add labels and title
plt.xlabel('Brand')
plt.ylabel('Price (USD)')
plt.title('Price Distribution of Digital Cameras by Brand')

# Save the plot as an image file
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
